description: Restore an archived article to where it was: an archived draft is a draft again, and an article that was published is published again on the customer's site, as the same post at the same address. Refused when another live article uses its address. Defaults to a DRY RUN. When the person asked for this, call it with confirm=true.

confirm.description: Set true to restore it (default: dry run)

name: restore_content
